assertions.assertion: Agent books a one-way one-stop economy itinerary from a New York airport to SEA on 2024-05-20 departing after 11:00 EST, with 3 free baggages and no insurance, for a $255 total fare. The canonical itinerary is JFK to ATL to SEA via HAT136 and HAT039; any other one-stop economy itinerary at the same $255 fare departing after 11:00 EST is equally acceptable.
assertions.rationale: The agent did not book any itinerary. After failing to find direct flights meeting the customer's criteria on May 20, the agent did not attempt to search for one-stop connecting flights via alternate hubs (as the task description suggests was possible), instead claiming it lacked the capability to search for connecting flights and ultimately transferring the customer to a human agent.

assertions.assertion: Agent charges $250 on payment method certificate_7504069 and $5 on credit_card_4421486.
assertions.rationale: No payment was ever processed. Since no booking was completed, no charges were made on either payment method.

assertions.assertion: Agent should call `search_direct_flight` with airport codes (JFK, EWR, LGA, SEA), not city names ('New York', 'Seattle'). City-name queries return empty results and waste turns.
assertions.rationale: The agent consistently called search_direct_flight with airport codes: JFK as origin and SEA as destination on every search (May 20, 21, 22, and 23), never using city names.

assertions.assertion: When no direct flight exists, agent should search candidate connecting hubs to build a one-stop itinerary, not declare the booking impossible. The agent has the same search tool used in multi-leg searches elsewhere in this dataset.
assertions.rationale: When no direct flights met the customer's departure-time criteria, the agent declared the booking impossible via connecting flights, stating 'I'm only able to search for direct flights' and 'I'm not able to search for flights with stopovers,' then transferred the customer rather than attempting to search for one-stop options through connecting hubs.

summary: Agent failed to complete the booking; it incorrectly claimed inability to search for connecting flights and transferred the customer instead of attempting one-stop searches through connecting hubs.
